# Discount Decision: DR-9110 (Acme Manufacturing, NS-500, 8%)

**Yes.** Sarah Chen could have approved this herself on 2025-03-31, but not on the basis the request gives.

**Eligibility comes from the 2023 exception, not the Master Supply Agreement.**
- The request cites "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement". That agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) and its 15% exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-15) only took effect on **2025-04-01**, the day after the request date. Neither covered this request.
- The exception that did apply on 2025-03-31 is **EXC-ACME-NS500-10**, under agreement ACME-SA-2023. It covers NS-500 orders placed from 2023-04-01 to 2025-03-31, up to **10%** off list.
- The account is CRM-2048, Acme Manufacturing, which is ERP C-1001, Acme Mfg. Holdings (same DUNS 04-812-7730). The product is NS-500.
- 8% is within the 10% maximum, so Acme was eligible.

**Sarah had the authority.**
- Northstar Pricing Policy 2025 was in force on 2025-03-31. Under it, Enterprise Account Executives may approve discounts up to and including 15%.
- Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive, and 8% is within that limit.
- The 2026 Approval Authority Matrix (10% limit) does not apply to a 2025 request.
- No discount policy bars an Account Executive from approving her own request.

**Two things to note:**
- **The justification cites the wrong terms.** It should name EXC-ACME-NS500-10 (ACME-SA-2023), because the agreement it cites was not yet in effect.
- **The request ID looks out of sequence.** DR-9110 comes after DR-9001, which was logged on 2026-09-23, yet DR-9110 is dated 2025-03-31. That suggests it may have been entered or backdated recently. I decided on the date in the system of record. The outcome would be the same on any date from 2025-01-01 to today: 8% is within both exceptions' maximums (10% and 15%) and within the Account Executive limit under both the 2025 policy (15%) and the 2026 policy (10%).

  "outcome": "APPROVE",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9110", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048 / ERP C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": 8.0,
              "date": "2025-03-31", "requestor": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "eligible",
                             "maximum_discount": 10.0, "basis": "EXC-ACME-NS500-10 (agreement ACME-SA-2023), covering NS-500 orders 2023-04-01 to 2025-03-31; ACME-MFG-2025 / EXC-ACME-NS500-15 not effective until 2025-04-01"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2025", "requestor_limit": 15.0, "requestor_authorized": true,
                "required_role": "Enterprise Account Executive", "approver": null},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv DR-9110", "EXC-ACME-NS500-10", "ACME-MFG-2025 (effective 2025-04-01)", "EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (effective 2025-04-01)", "PRICING-POLICY-2025", "structured/employees.csv EMP-101", "structured/crm_accounts.csv CRM-2048", "structured/customers.csv C-1001", "SOP-SALES-014"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Correct the CRM justification: it cites the Acme Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025), which was not effective on 2025-03-31; record EXC-ACME-NS500-10 (ACME-SA-2023) as the eligibility basis", "who": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "blocking": false},
    {"what": "Confirm the 2025-03-31 request date is genuine; request ID DR-9110 follows DR-9001 (2026-09-23), suggesting late entry or backdating. The outcome is unchanged for any date from 2025-01-01 to the present", "who": "Revenue Operations", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
